title: OTP Expired Twice
human_truth: Some couples are not calm under tiny pressure; they become a two-person panic system that somehow works.
emotional_arc: harmless timer pressure -> Aachu fast panic -> Zuv too-calm flawed reading -> shared failure -> side-by-side reset -> tiny success -> earned laughter
slide_summaries: He reads too calmly while she types too fast.
One unclear digit freezes both of them.
The OTP expires and they share a deadpan pause.
They reset side by side for the resend.
They laugh because the tiny task felt like a mission.
